## Sales Pipeline

DEVIATION: built as a NEW standalone component (`@items` argument) rather than extracted live from `revenue-os.gts`'s isolated view. That file's board logic is deeply tied to its own tracked filter state, and its full dependency closure reaches into unrelated Legal/Contract files not vendored for this build — it could not be render-verified locally before push, so editing it blind was judged too risky. Same capability as the inline version: stage columns (from `pipeline-stage-field.gts`), sort by value/probability/staleness, forecast-window filter (all/week/month/quarter). Wraps the realm's existing generic `Board` component rather than reimplementing Kanban rendering.

### Non-goals
Does not run its own query — takes `@items` from the consumer, so it works identically whether items come from a live realm search or a fixed list. Switching `revenue-os.gts` to actually consume this component (instead of its current inline duplicate) is an explicit, separate follow-up, not done in this pass.

### Example
No linked example yet — `board-demo.gts`'s `PipelineBoardDemo` is a natural second consumer if it's ever switched over.
attributes.cardDescription: A Kanban board of Opportunities/Deals grouped by Pipeline Stage, with sort and close-window filtering — the daily-use view for a sales team.
